Die Chimanimani New Road bietet entlang der Buzi-Senke spektakuläre Aussichten auf die zerklüfteten Berglandschaften der Eastern Highlands.
A Buzi-medence mentén haladó Chimanimani New Road látványos kilátást nyújt a Keleti-felföld zord hegyi tájaira.
Noul drum Chimanimani de-a lungul bazinului Buzi oferă vederi spectaculoase asupra peisajelor montane accidentate din Eastern Highlands.
The Chimanimani new road offers spectacular views along the Buzi basin looking towards the rugged mountain landscapes of the Eastern Highlands.
